Message: This controller uses the second Glasgow Interface Explorer USB device (Glasgow.Device1).
Simulate=true performs no USB or motor operation.
Pin names use Glasgow port notation, not Raspberry Pi BCM numbering.
The committed pin, travel, and timing values are commissioning placeholders.
Before Simulate=false, configure Device1.Id, verify STEP/DIR/EN wiring, driver polarity, travel limits, emergency stop, and safe motor current.
